introHtml: Green badge reels offer a vibrant, natural color that stands out in any workplace. Whether you're outfitting a safety team or a corporate office, these reels add a pop of color while keeping IDs accessible. Choose from neon green for high visibility or deeper shades for a professional look. Options like the Jumbo Neon Round Badge Reel in Chroma or Polydome finishes provide durability and smooth retraction. Decorate with your logo using pad printing or screen printing for a crisp, lasting impression.
